placeHelp: Type the beginning of its name, then pick it from the list. It must exist in « Places ».
placeNone: No place of that name in « Places ».
placeSearchFailed: The search for places did not go through. Try again in a moment.
placeSheetsFailed: The sheets already entered for this place could not be read: a duplicate sheet will be refused when saved.
dateHelp: A year is enough: the sheet holds for that year. Filling in the end makes it a span. A place cannot have two sheets for the same year.
calendarHelp: The day counted in the Julian or the Gregorian calendar.
importanceHelp: When the city appears on the map: a capital is seen from afar, a large city as you zoom in, a city close up.
unreachable: The server does not answer: the sheet is not saved. What you typed is kept; try again in a moment.
serverFault: The server answered unexpectedly: the sheet is not saved. What you typed is kept; the detail is in the browser’s console.
yearMissing: A year at least is needed.
marginRange: A margin of 1 year at least.
yearZero: There is no year 0: 1 BC is followed by AD 1.
dayWithoutCalendar: A day needs its calendar, Julian or Gregorian.
calendarWithoutDay: A calendar only matters for a day.
noSuchDay: That month has no such day that year.
marginWithoutCirca: A margin only goes with « circa »: an exact year has none.
reversed: The end comes before the start.
reasonsHelp: Why it has that importance: power, religion, trade… Optional. The list is completed in « Importance reasons ».
reasonsNone: No reason entered yet: the list is completed in « Importance reasons ».
testimoniesHelp: Optional. One line for each thing a source says of the city at that date — for example: Buringh 2021, population, 25,000.
sourceHelp: Type the beginning of its title, then pick it. It must exist in « Sources ».
sourceNone: No source of that title in « Sources ».
sourceSearchFailed: The search for sources did not go through. Try again in a moment.
subject: About
subjectHelp: What the source speaks about: the population, the importance, or a reason.
whereHelp: Where the source says it: a page, a line, a column. Optional.
subjectMissing: Say what the source speaks about.
populationInvalid: The number of inhabitants, whole, from 0.
lineImportanceMissing: Choose the importance the source gives.
reasonMissing: Choose the reason the source gives.
lineImportanceHelp: The order of city the source gives it.
reasonResults: {count, plural, =0 {no reason} one {# reason} other {# reasons}}
holderHelp: The polity holding the city at this date, by its name — for instance: Republic of Venice. Optional. It is what the Cartographer compares with the polity drawn under the city.
holderQidHelp: The polity’s, not the city’s — for instance: Q4948 for Venice. Optional: a polity that has none is entered by its name alone. Check it on Wikidata: imported maps carry wrong ones.
holderNameMissing: Give the polity’s name: an id alone cannot be read.
qidInvalid: A Wikidata id is Q followed by digits — for instance: Q4948.
lineHolderHelp: The polity holding the city according to this source, by its name.
lineHolderMissing: Give the polity the source names.
quotationHelp: The source’s own words, copied as they are. Optional, but it is what lets the line be checked without the book.
showInAtlas: Show the city in the atlas
showInAtlasHelp: Ticked, the city appears in the published atlas. Unticked, it stays in the contribution and in the Cartographer, which uses it to place the borders.
